tools.description: List every AI model available on JarvisClaw — GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and more — with the model IDs you plug straight into the chat tool. Free, and the fastest way to see what you can call.

tools.name: chat

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_models, discover_agents, aip_execute_with_budget, aip_list_intents · Private data: search_apis · Public sink: chat, get_api_detail · Destructive: aip_resolve, aip_execute_with_budget, aip_list_intents.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_models, discover_agents, aip_execute_with_budget, aip_list_intents · Private data: search_apis · Public sink: chat, get_api_detail · Destructive: aip_resolve, aip_execute_with_budget, aip_list_intents

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_apis" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
